assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE isolated outdoor roadside waymarker sprite for Chronforge Echo, a richly detailed painted pixel-art science-fantasy RPG. This sprite will stand about 62 logical pixels tall beside an adult character about 78 pixels tall.
Subject: a practical weathered wooden WAYMARKER, a broad RECTANGULAR upright notice board mounted high on one sturdy square timber post. The board is wider than its height, with straight blunt ends, no arrow shape. Two horizontal honey-brown planks form the board face. Aged copper corner brackets with small rivets, a narrow worn muted teal paint strip, subtle carved wood grain and nicks, and a simple ivory engraved winding route line joining THREE ROUND dots. The engraving is decorative route marks, absolutely no written text or letters. A small round copper seal may be centered at the top. The lower post ends in a worn dark metal foot collar; complete flat planted foot.
Style: hand-painted detailed pixel sprite matching rich timber/copper/teal lanterns and salvage props, clean stepped pixel contours, compact layered material shading, dark brown occlusion, warm upper-left light, restrained fine outline. Visibly textured craftsmanship, not a flat geometric icon, not vector, not a photograph, not a shiny 3D toy.
Composition: entire complete standing object at slight elevated three-quarter game view, front board face clearly visible with only a little right-side thickness. Overall silhouette approximately 0.8 as wide as tall. Board spans the upper half; sturdy post extends to ground. Center within a square canvas with at least 12% transparent margin ALL around, no part clipped. No canopy, no lantern, no cloth flags, no hanging ornament, no grass, no stones, no ground plane, no cast shadow.
Background: genuinely transparent RGBA exterior, preserve the generated alpha. DO NOT paint a checkerboard or white backdrop. One object only, no spritesheet, no extra variants, no characters or portraits. NO arrows, no cardinal-direction symbols, no readable or unreadable pseudo-text, no letters, numbers, border, watermark or logo.
assets.processing: Original PNG copied unchanged. Runtime draws a measured crop with original alpha; no color-keying.
